theorems.name: Submission.dor_ims_action_eq_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Integrable (fun x => R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) R.measure ∧ R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = ∫ x, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂R.measure
